facts.status_note: Register says the cab was removed in 1968; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968; an Oregon Lookouts page says it was disposed of by burning on site on October 27, 1967. No source describes the site now.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date removal or destruction to 1968, while the Oregon Lookouts page dates burning on site to October 27, 1967, and a November 3, 1967 memo covers the burn approval. The story reports both dates and the wording of each.
The register gives 5,618 ft (1,712 m). A 1939 Albany Democrat-Herald item quoted on the Oregon Lookouts page says 5656 feet. The record keeps the register figure, which matches the brief.

notes_for_editor: Gone status is supported. Sources disagree on how the lookout ended: the register and firelookout.com say removed or destroyed in 1968, while the Oregon Lookouts page dates disposal by burning on site to October 27, 1967. The 1939 item gives 5656 ft where the register gives 5,618 ft. Access and the site today are not in any source; the story says so. Staffing is emergency, as of 1939, per the Albany Democrat-Herald item; the 1934 CCC construction note is kept in the event list. Brief's record for ground site, elevation 1712 m and FFLOS registration was accurate. No web search used; three source pages read.
